name: lien-monorepo
description: Lien - local-first code-health CLI: risk, complexity and review signals for a change

scripts.build: npm run build -w @liendev/parser && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @liendev/parser && npm run typecheck -w packages/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @liendev/parser-native && npm run test -w @liendev/parser && npm run test -w packages/cli
scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.fix: eslint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs && prettier --write packages/*/src/ packages/*/test/ packages/parser-native/index.js packages/parser-native/index.d.ts packages/parser-native/scripts/*.mjs

author: Alf Henderson
